name: za-capital-gains-tables
description: Year-keyed South African capital gains tax tables for natural persons, for the years of assessment 2023 to 2027, with the current year being the 2027 year of assessment (1 March 2026 to 28 February 2027, written 2026/27). Holds the annual exclusion, the exclusion in the year of death, the primary residence exclusion, the small business asset exclusion and its market value limit, the maximum effective CGT rates by type of taxpayer, and the tax-free investment annual and lifetime limits with the 40% charge on excess contributions, each row linked to the SARS page it was read on. Use for any South African CGT exclusion or effective rate lookup, primary residence disposal, deceased estate, small business disposal at 55 or older, or tax-free savings account limit question, current or prior year.
